repositories.name: claude-plugins-official
repositories.description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
repositories.summary: 这是 Anthropic 维护的 Claude Code 插件目录，收录官方与第三方高质量插件，供用户浏览和安装。

repositories.name: ai-job-search
repositories.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
repositories.summary: 这是一个基于 Claude Code 的求职申请框架，可在本机运行，用于评估职位、定制简历、撰写求职信和准备面试。

repositories.name: ECC
repositories.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repositories.summary: ECC 是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程代理的性能优化系统，提供技能、记忆、安全与先研究后开发的工程化工具链。

repositories.name: CLI-Anything
repositories.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
repositories.summary: CLI-Anything 是让各类软件具备智能体原生接口的工具，通过 CLI-Hub 安装现成命令行工具，或用七阶段生成器为软件自动构建 CLI。

repositories.name: scientific-agent-skills
repositories.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
repositories.summary: 这是一个面向科研的 AI 智能体技能库，提供 177 个经校验的科学技能和 100 多个生物、化学、医学与药物发现数据库，让 AI 编程助手能执行科研任务。

repositories.name: ai-memory
repositories.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
repositories.summary: ai-memory 是面向 AI 编程代理的长期记忆工具，用于跨会话保存上下文，并在不同代理之间交接任务。

repositories.name: skills
repositories.summary: 该仓库提供面向 AI 代理的模块化 Android 开发技能说明文件，帮助模型按官方最佳实践完成特定开发任务。

repositories.name: orca
repositories.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
repositories.summary: Orca 是一个用 TypeScript 开发的 AI 编码代理编排工具，可在桌面、移动端和远程运行环境中并行运行多个 CLI 编码代理，并统一跟踪管理。

repositories.name: claude-code
repositories.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
repositories.summary: Claude Code 是运行在终端里的智能编程工具，能理解代码库，通过自然语言命令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码并处理 Git 工作流。

repositories.name: VoiceStudio
repositories.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
repositories.summary: VoiceStudio 是一个完全本地运行的开源语音工具，支持声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转写和有声书制作，覆盖 646 种语言。

repositories.name: opencode
repositories.summary: OpenCode 是一个用 TypeScript 开发的开源 AI 编程代理，提供命令行和桌面应用，内置 build 与 plan 两种代理，用于辅助开发、代码分析与探索。

repositories.name: ruflo
repositories.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
repositories.summary: Ruflo 是面向 Claude Code 和 Codex 的智能体元框架，用于部署多智能体集群、协调自动化工作流并构建对话式 AI 系统。

repositories.name: xerj
repositories.description: XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep (1974 tool). One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. It’s durable and can replace ElasticSearch saving you x10 infra costs.
repositories.summary: XERJ 是 Rust 编写的本地 AI 搜索工具，可自动索引文件夹中的代码、文档和日志，供编码代理检索，减少 token 消耗。
